firm_data.firm_name: The Law Offices of Melissa A. Day, PLLC
firm_data.firm_description: The Law Offices of Melissa A. Day, PLLC is a workers’ compensation defense firm committed to representing organizations with a focus on claim-based partnerships centered around collaboration, communication, and honesty.
notable_facts: The firm was named a finalist for Best Places to Work Buffalo in 2021.
The firm has been listed as one of the Largest Buffalo Law Firms and Largest Women-Owned Businesses in Buffalo multiple years.
technology_signals: Early proponents of the board’s exciting new virtual technology.

email.subject: AI for The Law Offices of Melissa A. Day, PLLC - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Melissa,

Your firm's early adoption of virtual technology tells me you're thinking ahead. As a workers' compensation defense practice built on collaboration and efficiency, you're exactly who we built Lucio for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Buffalo to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping practices like yours compete with BigLaw on workers' compensation and subrogation work.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
